title: Selected AC1032 large-radial dimension output and typed readback
scope: Verify selected-record DXF transport of the tracked AC1032 LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION fixture, including its common dimension fields and jogged radial points. This does not qualify the source drawing's complete graph or visual rendering.

source.repositoryStatus: Already tracked in libdxfrw; no fixture added or modified

method.reader: FixtureInterface::fileImport through the production DWG reader and dx_iface callbacks
method.selection: Copy the single typed DRW_DimLargeRadial record into a fresh dx_data together with the source HEADER and line type, layer, DIMSTYLE, text-style and APPID tables. Clear group 2 on the isolated copy so no edge points to the deliberately omitted named picture block; other source records and that block graph are not copied.
method.writer: Production dx_iface::fileExport to AC1032 ASCII and Binary DXF
method.readback: Fresh FixtureInterface::fileImport and require exactly one typed DRW_DimLargeRadial callback per emitted file

fieldsCompared: dimension name, explicit text, style, type and attachment
text-line style/factor, direction and horizontal direction
extrusion vector, center point and text point
chord point, overridden center, jog vertex and jog angle

focusedTest.result: PASS, 1/1; tracked AC1032 fixture import plus selected-record ASCII/Binary writer output and typed readback

limitations: The isolated projection clears group 2 and does not include the fixture's named dimension picture block; picture-block graph closure and rendered appearance are not qualified.
Typed DXF readback verifies field transport only. No independent geometry engine or native CAD evaluation was used.
The result does not qualify strict whole-document conversion, other producers or versions, or general dimension support.

planImpact.completedSlice: The single typed AC1032 large-radial record from the tracked fixture survives production ASCII and Binary DXF output and typed readback for the compared common and jog-specific fields.
planImpact.remaining: Dimension picture-block graph closure, native display/evaluation, additional source profiles, and other P6 semantic/version boundaries.
planImpact.nextReadyPacket: Continue the P6 residual audit on a source-backed annotation or geometry profile; preserve strict graph closure and keep native behavior claims unqualified.
